result.stdout:
Usage
  review-me                       Automatically determine review target; see section below for details
  review-me --uncommitted         Review a diff for all uncommitted changes
  review-me --diff $REF           Review a diff from the current commit to $REF (can be a branch or a commit hash)
  review-me --file $PATH          Review the file at $PATH
  review-me config $KEY           Get the current value for $KEY
  review-me config $KEY $VALUE    Set $VALUE as config for $KEY

Automatic review target:
 1) If there are uncommitted changes on the current branch, these are compared (=> --uncommitted)
 2) If HEAD is not master or main, HEAD is compared to the default branch (=> --diff master or --diff main)
 3) Otherwise, HEAD is compared against origin/HEAD (=> --diff origin/master or --diff origin/main)
